blocks.text: Teamwork and knowledge sharing mean working on group projects with each member contributing expertise, for example sharing research findings in a science project, and exchanging ideas in study groups or discussions to deepen understanding.

blocks.prompt: Name one digital tool that helps a team share knowledge.
blocks.explanation: A shared document or drive (such as Google Docs) where everyone can add and edit research.

items: Teamwork: everyone contributes and shares what they learn.
